items.source: If you do use an iframe-based transport, keep in mind that browsers can be instructed to block the use of IFrames on a given page by setting the HTTP response header X-Frame-Options to DENY, SAMEORIGIN, or ALLOW-FROM <origin>. This is used to prevent clickjacking.
items.translation: 如果您使用基于 iframe 的传输方式，请注意浏览器可以通过将 HTTP 响应头 X-Frame-Options 设置为 DENY、SAMEORIGIN 或 ALLOW-FROM <origin> 来阻止在给定页面上使用 IFrames。这用于防止点击劫持。

items.source: SockJS adds minimal message framing. For example, the server sends the letter o (“open” frame) initially, messages are sent as a["message1","message2"] (JSON-encoded array), the letter h (“heartbeat” frame) if no messages flow for 25 seconds (by default), and the letter c (“close” frame) to close the session.
items.translation: SockJS 添加了最小的消息帧。例如，服务器最初发送字母o（“打开”帧），消息作为a["message1","message2"]（JSON 编码的数组）发送，如果在默认情况下 25 秒内没有消息流动，则发送字母h（“心跳”帧），并发送字母c（“关闭”帧）以关闭会话。

items.source: The preceding example is for use in Spring MVC applications and should be included in the configuration of a DispatcherServlet. However, Spring’s WebSocket and SockJS support does not depend on Spring MVC. It is relatively simple to integrate into other HTTP serving environments with the help of SockJsHttpRequestHandler.
items.translation: 前面的示例适用于 Spring MVC 应用程序，应包含在 DispatcherServlet 的配置中。然而，Spring 的 WebSocket 和 SockJS 支持并不依赖于 Spring MVC。借助 SockJsHttpRequestHandler，将其集成到其他 HTTP 服务环境中相对简单。

items.source: The first /info request from the SockJS client is a request for information that can influence the client’s choice of transports. One of those details is whether the server application relies on cookies (for example, for authentication purposes or clustering with sticky sessions). Spring’s SockJS support includes a property called sessionCookieNeeded. It is enabled by default, since most Java applications rely on the JSESSIONID cookie. If your application does not need it, you can turn off this option, and SockJS client should then choose xdr-streaming in IE 8 and 9.
items.translation: SockJS 客户端的第一个 /info 请求是一个信息请求，可能会影响客户端对传输方式的选择。其中的一个细节是服务器应用程序是否依赖 Cookie（例如用于身份验证或带有粘性会话的集群）。Spring 的 SockJS 支持包含一个名为 sessionCookieNeeded 的属性。该属性默认启用，因为大多数 Java 应用程序都依赖 JSESSIONID Cookie。如果您的应用程序不需要它，可以关闭此选项，SockJS 客户端随后将在 IE 8 和 9 中选择 xdr-streaming。

items.source: {transport} indicates the transport type (for example, websocket, xhr-streaming, and others).
items.translation: {transport} 表示传输类型（例如，websocket、xhr-streaming 等）。

items.source: To learn more, run an example in a browser and watch the HTTP requests. The SockJS client allows fixing the list of transports, so it is possible to see each transport one at a time. The SockJS client also provides a debug flag, which enables helpful messages in the browser console. On the server side, you can enable TRACE logging for org.springframework.web.socket. For even more detail, see the SockJS protocol narrated test.
items.translation: 要了解更多，请在浏览器中运行示例并观察 HTTP 请求。SockJS 客户端允许固定传输列表，因此可以逐个查看每种传输方式。SockJS 客户端还提供调试标志，可在浏览器控制台中启用有用的消息。在服务器端，您可以为 org.springframework.web.socket 启用 TRACE 日志记录。若要获取更详细的信息，请参阅 SockJS 协议的叙述测试。

items.source: On the browser side, applications can use the sockjs-client (version 1.0.x). It emulates the W3C WebSocket API and communicates with the server to select the best transport option, depending on the browser in which it runs. See the sockjs-client page and the list of transport types supported by browser. The client also provides several configuration options — for example, to specify which transports to include.
items.translation: 在浏览器端，应用程序可以使用 sockjs-client（版本 1.0.x）。它模拟了 W3C WebSocket API，并与服务器通信以选择最佳传输选项，具体取决于其运行的浏览器。请查看 sockjs-client 页面以及浏览器支持的传输类型列表。客户端还提供多种配置选项——例如，可以指定要包含哪些传输方式。

items.source: See Default Security Headers of the Spring Security documentation for details on how to configure the setting of the X-Frame-Options header. You can also see gh-2718 for additional background.
items.translation: 有关如何配置 X-Frame-Options 标头的详细信息，请参阅 Spring Security 文档中的默认安全标头。您还可以查看gh-2718以获取更多背景信息。

items.source: If your application adds the X-Frame-Options response header (as it should!) and relies on an iframe-based transport, you need to set the header value to SAMEORIGIN or ALLOW-FROM <origin>. The Spring SockJS support also needs to know the location of the SockJS client, because it is loaded from the iframe. By default, the iframe is set to download the SockJS client from a CDN location. It is a good idea to configure this option to use a URL from the same origin as the application.
items.translation: 如果您的应用程序添加了 X-Frame-Options 响应头（应该这样做！）并依赖基于 iframe 的传输，则需要将 header 值设置为 SAMEORIGIN 或 ALLOW-FROM <origin>。Spring SockJS 支持还需要知道 SockJS 客户端的位置，因为它是从 iframe 中加载的。默认情况下，iframe 被配置为从 CDN 位置下载 SockJS 客户端。建议将此选项配置为使用与应用程序相同源点的 URL。

items.source: For the exact implementation, see addCorsHeaders in AbstractSockJsService and the TransportType enum in the source code.
items.translation: 对于具体实现，请参见源代码中的AbstractSockJsService里的addCorsHeaders以及TransportType枚举。

items.source: The SockJS Java client supports the websocket, xhr-streaming, and xhr-polling transports. The remaining ones only make sense for use in a browser.
items.translation: SockJS Java 客户端支持 websocket、xhr-streaming 和 xhr-polling 传输。其余的仅适用于浏览器环境。

items.source: An XhrTransport, by definition, supports both xhr-streaming and xhr-polling, since, from a client perspective, there is no difference other than in the URL used to connect to the server. At present there are two implementations:
items.translation: XhrTransport 根据定义，同时支持 xhr-streaming 和 xhr-polling，因为从客户端角度来看，除了用于连接服务器的 URL 不同之外，两者没有其他区别。目前有两个实现：

items.source: The SockJS protocol defined in the form of executable narrated tests.
items.translation: SockJS 协议以可执行的叙述性测试形式定义在 SockJS 协议中。

items.source: SockJS is designed for use in browsers. It uses a variety of techniques to support a wide range of browser versions. For the full list of SockJS transport types and browsers, see the SockJS client page. Transports fall in three general categories: WebSocket, HTTP Streaming, and HTTP Long Polling. For an overview of these categories, see this blog post.
items.translation: SockJS 专为浏览器使用而设计。它采用多种技术以支持广泛的浏览器版本。有关 SockJS 传输类型和浏览器的完整列表，请参阅 SockJS client 页面。传输方式分为三大类：WebSocket、HTTP 流和 HTTP 长轮询。有关这些类别的概述，请参阅 这篇博客文章。

items.source: The SockJS client supports Ajax/XHR streaming in IE 8 and 9 by using Microsoft’s XDomainRequest. That works across domains but does not support sending cookies. Cookies are often essential for Java applications. However, since the SockJS client can be used with many server types (not just Java ones), it needs to know whether cookies matter. If so, the SockJS client prefers Ajax/XHR for streaming. Otherwise, it relies on an iframe-based technique.
items.translation: SockJS 客户端通过使用 Microsoft 的 XDomainRequest 支持在 IE 8 和 9 中的 Ajax/XHR 流式传输。该方案支持跨域，但不支持发送 Cookie。Cookie 对于 Java 应用程序通常至关重要。然而，由于 SockJS 客户端可用于多种服务器类型（而不仅仅是 Java），因此需要知道 Cookie 是否重要。如果是这样，SockJS 客户端将优先使用 Ajax/XHR 进行流式传输；否则，它将依赖基于 iframe 的技术。

items.source: Spring Security 3.2+ provides support for setting X-Frame-Options on every response. By default, the Spring Security Java configuration sets it to DENY. In 3.2, the Spring Security XML namespace does not set that header by default but can be configured to do so. In the future, it may set it by default.
items.translation: Spring Security 3.2+ 支持为每个响应设置 X-Frame-Options。默认情况下，Spring Security Java 配置将其设置为 DENY。在 3.2 版本中，Spring Security XML 命名空间默认不会设置该标头，但可以配置以进行设置。未来可能会默认设置它。

items.source: The SockJS protocol requires servers to send heartbeat messages to preclude proxies from concluding that a connection is hung. The Spring SockJS configuration has a property called heartbeatTime that you can use to customize the frequency. By default, a heartbeat is sent after 25 seconds, assuming no other messages were sent on that connection. This 25-second value is in line with the following IETF recommendation for public Internet applications.
items.translation: SockJS 协议要求服务器发送心跳消息，以防止代理认为连接已挂起。Spring SockJS 配置有一个名为 heartbeatTime 的属性，可用于自定义频率。默认情况下，如果该连接上没有发送其他消息，则在 25 秒后发送一次心跳。此 25 秒的值符合以下针对公共互联网应用程序的 IETF 建议。

items.source: If you allow cross-origin requests (see Allowed Origins), the SockJS protocol uses CORS for cross-domain support in the XHR streaming and polling transports. Therefore, CORS headers are added automatically, unless the presence of CORS headers in the response is detected. So, if an application is already configured to provide CORS support (for example, through a Servlet Filter), Spring’s SockJsService skips this part.
items.translation: 如果您允许跨域请求（参见允许的源），SockJS 协议将在 XHR 流式传输和轮询传输中使用 CORS 来支持跨域。因此，除非检测到响应中已存在 CORS 头，否则会自动添加 CORS 头。所以，如果应用程序已经配置为提供 CORS 支持（例如通过 Servlet Filter），Spring 的SockJsService将跳过此部分。

items.source: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: Initialized from the value of the Origin request header.
items.translation: Access-Control-Allow-Origin：从 Origin 请求头的值初始化。
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials：始终设置为 true。

items.source: Access-Control-Allow-Methods: The HTTP methods a transport supports (see TransportType enum).
items.translation: Access-Control-Allow-Methods：传输支持的方法（参见 TransportType 枚举）。
RestTemplateXhrTransport 使用 Spring 的 RestTemplate 进行 HTTP 请求。
JettyXhrTransport 使用 Jetty 的 HttpClient 进行 HTTP 请求。

items.source: Over the public Internet, restrictive proxies outside your control may preclude WebSocket interactions, either because they are not configured to pass on the Upgrade header or because they close long-lived connections that appear to be idle.
items.translation: 在公共互联网上，您无法控制的限制性代理可能会阻止 WebSocket 交互，原因可能是它们未配置为转发Upgrade请求头，或者因为它们关闭了看似空闲的长连接。

items.translation: SockJS JavaScript 客户端 — 用于浏览器的客户端库。

items.translation: SockJS 服务器实现，包括 Spring Framework 的spring-websocket模块中的一个。

items.source: A SockJS Java client in the spring-websocket module (since version 4.1).
items.translation: spring-websocket 模块中的 SockJS Java 客户端（自版本 4.1 起）。

items.source: The SockJS client begins by sending GET /info to obtain basic information from the server. After that, it must decide what transport to use. If possible, WebSocket is used. If not, in most browsers, there is at least one HTTP streaming option. If not, then HTTP (long) polling is used.
items.translation: SockJS 客户端首先发送 GET /info 以从服务器获取基本信息。之后，它必须决定使用何种传输方式。如果可能，则使用 WebSocket；否则，在大多数浏览器中，至少有一种 HTTP 流式传输选项可用；如果仍不可用，则使用 HTTP（长）轮询。

items.source: {server-id} is useful for routing requests in a cluster but is not used otherwise.
items.translation: {server-id} 可用于集群中的请求路由，但除此之外不使用。

items.source: {session-id} correlates HTTP requests belonging to a SockJS session.
items.translation: {session-id} 关联属于 SockJS 会话的 HTTP 请求。

items.source: The XML namespace provides a similar option through the <websocket:sockjs> element.
items.translation: XML 命名空间通过 `<websocket:sockjs>` 元素提供了类似选项。

items.source: The Spring SockJS support also lets you configure the TaskScheduler to schedule heartbeats tasks. The task scheduler is backed by a thread pool, with default settings based on the number of available processors. You should consider customizing the settings according to your specific needs.
items.translation: Spring SockJS 支持还允许您配置 TaskScheduler 以调度心跳任务。任务调度器由线程池支持，其默认设置基于可用处理器数量。您应根据具体需求考虑自定义这些设置。

items.source: HTTP streaming and HTTP long polling SockJS transports require a connection to remain open longer than usual. For an overview of these techniques, see this blog post.
items.translation: HTTP 流和 HTTP 长轮询 SockJS 传输需要连接保持打开状态的时间比通常更长。有关这些技术的概述，请参阅这篇博客文章。

items.source: A specific issue is that the Servlet API does not provide notifications for a client that has gone away. See eclipse-ee4j/servlet-api#44. However, Servlet containers raise an exception on subsequent attempts to write to the response. Since Spring’s SockJS Service supports server-sent heartbeats (every 25 seconds by default), that means a client disconnect is usually detected within that time period (or earlier, if messages are sent more frequently).
items.translation: 一个特定问题是 Servlet API 不会为已断开的客户端提供通知。参见 eclipse-ee4j/servlet-api#44。然而，Servlet 容器会在后续尝试向响应写入时抛出异常。由于 Spring 的 SockJS Service 支持服务器发送的心跳（默认每 25 秒一次），这意味着客户端断开连接通常会在该时间段内（或如果消息发送频率更高则更早）被检测到。

items.source: It is also possible to disable the addition of these CORS headers by setting the suppressCors property in Spring’s SockJsService.
items.translation: 也可以通过在 Spring 的 SockJsService 中设置 suppressCors 属性来禁用这些 CORS 头的添加。

items.translation: Access-Control-Request-Headers：从等效的请求头值初始化。
Access-Control-Max-Age：设置为 31536000（1 年）。

first and then falling back on HTTP-based techniques that emulate a WebSocket

non-WebSocket alternatives when necessary at runtime, without the need to
change application code.

All messages thereafter are exchanged on that socket.

HTTP transports require more requests. Ajax/XHR streaming, for example, relies on
one long-running request for server-to-client messages and additional HTTP POST
requests for client-to-server messages. Long polling is similar, except that it
ends the current request after each server-to-client send.
items.translation: HTTP 传输需要更多的请求。例如，Ajax/XHR 流式传输依赖于一个长连接请求来接收服务器到客户端的消息，并需要额外的 HTTP POST 请求来发送客户端到服务器的消息。长轮询与此类似，不同之处在于它在每次服务器到客户端的发送后结束当前请求。

items.source: As a result, network I/O failures can occur because a client has disconnected, which can fill the log with unnecessary stack traces. Spring makes a best effort to identify such network failures that represent client disconnects (specific to each server) and log a minimal message by using the dedicated log category, DISCONNECTED_CLIENT_LOG_CATEGORY (defined in AbstractSockJsSession). If you need to see the stack traces, you can set that log category to TRACE.
items.translation: 因此，由于客户端断开连接，可能会导致网络 I/O 失败，从而在日志中填充不必要的堆栈跟踪。Spring 会尽力识别此类代表客户端断开的网络故障（针对每个服务器特定），并使用专用日志类别 DISCONNECTED_CLIENT_LOG_CATEGORY（定义在 AbstractSockJsSession 中）记录最小化消息。如果您需要查看堆栈跟踪，可以将该日志类别设置为 TRACE。

items.source: SockJS uses JSON formatted arrays for messages. By default, Jackson 2 is used and needs to be on the classpath. Alternatively, you can configure a custom implementation of SockJsMessageCodec and configure it on the SockJsClient.
items.translation: SockJS 使用 JSON 格式的数组来传输消息。默认情况下，使用 Jackson 2，它需要位于类路径中。或者，您可以配置 SockJsMessageCodec 的自定义实现，并将其配置到 SockJsClient 上。

items.source: When using STOMP over WebSocket and SockJS, if the STOMP client and server negotiate heartbeats to be exchanged, the SockJS heartbeats are disabled.
items.translation: 在使用 WebSocket 和 SockJS 上的 STOMP 时，如果 STOMP 客户端和服务器协商交换心跳，则禁用 SockJS 心跳。
